pr_title: [CI] Adjust test case timeout to fit different scenarios

correspondence.review_quote: MengqingCao 指出两个 workflow 文件中的注释应删除。作者通过 commit `92bca21` 移除了不必要的注释，2/2 建议全部落地。

rule.description: CI workflow 文件中的注释应简洁明了，调试性或临时性注释不应留在最终代码中。
checkpoints: workflow 文件中是否有不必要的临时注释
注释是否对理解配置有帮助，还是冗余信息

antipattern.code:
- name: Run multi-node e2e nightly tests
      uses: ./.github/actions/e2e-test
      with:
        test_script: tests/e2e/nightly_multi_node.sh
        timeout-minutes: 60
        # TODO: adjust timeout after stabilization
        upload_logs: true
        artifact_name: multi-node-nightly

    - name: Upload test results
      if: always()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: multi-node-results
        path: test-results/
        retention-days: 7
